newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends firmer against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends firmer against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed firmer at 42.3500/42.3800 to the dollar in interbank trading on Thursday compared with the previous 42.3800/42.3925.
The taka was quoted at 42.3750/42.3950 against the dollar in early trading.
Dealers attributed the gain to the remittance of some $10 million from Bangladeshis working abroad. There was, however, lack of demand for dollars from importers, they said.
The interbank call money rates closed at 4.0 percent to 4.5 percent against the previous 4.5-5.25 percent.
